project: Wuxia Life P69 Next Route Candidate Reconciliation
description: Compare the next plausible route candidates using current repo evidence, methodology fit, and bounded implementation risk, then select one route or declare no-go before any new bridge design begins.

userStories.title: Audit next-route candidate inventory
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an inventory of plausible next-route candidates so P69 compares real repo options instead of imaginary future routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize the plausible next-route candidates currently grounded in the repo
Cover at least jianghu_renown_sage and merchant_martial_patron
State each candidate's outcome type, linked origins, and existing evidence surfaces
Save docs/test-reports/p69-next-route-candidate-inventory.md
userStories.notes: Inventory covers both candidates with outcome types, linked origins, and evidence surfaces. Excluded merchant_magnate (already optimized) and healer_swordsman/demonic/orthodox (insufficient ordinary-origin evidence).

userStories.title: Lock P69 route-selection scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P69 stays a route-selection stage and does not turn into pre-implementation design work.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P69 to comparison, ranking, route selection, or no-go
Define allowed layers: documentation comparison, evidence synthesis, and risk ranking
List forbidden expansions: new bridge contracts, new implementation, and new validation platforms
Save docs/test-reports/p69-next-route-selection-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope contract defines 4 allowed layers, 5 forbidden expansion categories, quality-first priority order, no-go conditions, and P69/P70 boundary.

userStories.title: Compare repo evidence strength
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a direct comparison of each candidate's current repo evidence so the next route choice is grounded in what already exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare wiring evidence, proof, tests, closure reports, and lifetime-trace strength across the candidates
State which candidate already has prerequisites closer to a playable bridge and which does not
Separate implementation foundation from idea-level potential
Write the comparison into the P69 evidence artifact

userStories.title: Compare methodology fit
userStories.description: As a planner, I want to know which candidate best fits the merchant trilogy optimization sequence without forcing major redesign.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare the candidates against the merchant trilogy stage sequence and transfer rules
State which candidate better fits bridge to entry to later differentiation ordering
State which candidate would create clear scope drift if forced into the same pattern too early
Write the conclusion into the P69 comparison artifact

userStories.title: Compare bounded implementation risk
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded implementation-risk comparison so the next route choice reflects quality-first priorities rather than value density alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare bridge cost, expression cost, and validation cost across the candidates
State which candidate better fits small-step single-iteration implementation standards
State the likely no-go conditions for each candidate
Write the conclusion into the P69 comparison artifact

userStories.title: Select one route or declare no-go
userStories.description: As a planner, I want P69 to end with one selected route or a clear no-go so the next PRD does not start from ambiguity.
acceptanceCriteria: Output one recommended route or an explicit no-go conclusion
Bind the selection or no-go rationale to repo-grounded evidence
If merchant_martial_patron is not selected, state why
If jianghu_renown_sage is not selected, state why

userStories.title: Add narrow reinforcement if evidence is missing
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want only the smallest additional evidence work needed if the route comparison cannot be decided from current repo truth.
acceptanceCriteria: If current evidence is sufficient, record that no additional validation is needed
If current evidence is insufficient, add only the smallest candidate-comparison evidence needed
Do not enter bridge-contract or runtime implementation work
Relevant commands pass

userStories.title: Produce P69 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating which route is selected next and why it is the most stable quality-first continuation.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p69-next-route-candidate-closure-report.md
Summarize the inventory, scope contract, evidence comparison, methodology fit, implementation-risk comparison, and final route selection
State the boundary between P69 and P70
List defer reasons for the route that was not selected or for a no-go result
